associations.name: Naskapi
associations.associationType: Present specific community and government location
associations.evidenceNote: The Naskapi Nation of Kawawachikamach's actual Land page describes its community northeast of Schefferville and gives its address at Kawawachikamach, Quebec. This is one present community/government route for the broader Naskapi access point. The source also describes historical movement into Labrador; this initial Quebec route is not an exclusive homeland boundary or a current land-claim assessment.

associations.name: Mohawk
associations.evidenceNote: Kahnawà:ke's own Community and History sections identify it as a Mohawk/Kanien’kehá:ka community on the St. Lawrence just south of Montreal. The regional route indexes this specific Quebec community, not every Mohawk community or the entire historical Mohawk homeland. Kahnawà:ke, Akwesasne and other communities remain distinct; no treaty, citizenship or jurisdictional boundary is inferred.
